watches.name: Gamer 8 Bit
watches.description: Star Tuned for the next Drop - Click the " RETRO DIGITAL - GAMER 8 BIT An ode to the 80s era of 8 bit gaming. The ritual was always the same. You’d click the cartridge into place, and pray for a solid red light. If you saw the dreaded blinking screen, you knew the drill: pop it out, give it a quick "breath of life" across the pins, and try again. Then, the chiptune music would kick in, the CRT would hum with static electricity, you would grab your controller. Push START. It’s time to play.
